bill.title: Offshore Oil and Gas Worker Whistleblower Protection Act
bill.latestActionText: Referred to the House Committee on Education and Workforce.

classification.plainSummary: This bill would create protections for workers in the offshore oil and gas industry who report safety violations, environmental hazards, or other legal concerns to authorities. It would prohibit employers from retaliating against these whistleblowers through firing, demotion, or other adverse actions. Workers who face retaliation would have a legal process to seek remedies, including reinstatement and compensation.

industries.rationale: The bill directly regulates employment practices and whistleblower protections in the offshore oil and gas extraction sector.
The bill would create new whistleblower complaint procedures and enforcement mechanisms that would generate legal work for employment and regulatory attorneys.

ordinary.text: They wrote this bill. Sponsoring a bill about your own district's industry is the ordinary case, not the odd one.
Lawyers & Lobbyists is also the top donor sector for 2 other members from CA. That points to the industry being big in the state, not to anything about this member.

disclaimer: This tool places two public records next to each other: who donated to a member of Congress, and what that member legislated on. Any overlap you see is a correlation, not causation. It is not evidence of a quid pro quo, of influence, or of wrongdoing. Legislators routinely receive support from industries in their district for the same reason they legislate on them: those industries are there.
